name: web-pet-product-site-on-laptop-with-rock-and-ghost-title
title: Pet product site on a laptop resting on a rock with vertical ghost title
whatItIs: A green gradient background with a laptop showing a website hero of a dog drinking from a water bottle. The laptop rests on a grey rock, and a big translucent 'Paw Port' is written vertically at the right.
whatItMeans: Outdoorsy, friendly and simple; the rock ties the mockup to the outdoors theme.
techniques: Prop the device on a natural material that matches the brand story.
Use a vertical ghost title to fill space without competing.
Match background gradient to the site's hero photo.
Keep the mockup front and centre.

vocabulary.definition: Placing an object on a themed prop.
A large opening image on a website.
